headline: Brazil Confirms 2024 GDP Grew 3.4% According to Final IBGE Data
summary: Brazil's official statistics agency IBGE confirmed that the country's GDP grew 3.4% in 2024, with 11 out of 12 activity groups remaining stable or growing.
why: Final GDP revisions provide a definitive picture of economic growth, guiding macroeconomic forecasts and sovereign risk assessments for investors.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Stronger finalized GDP data reflects broader economic expansion.
